items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: I remember those guys, because I have a sneaky suspicion that that's how Fats happened to propose to me about coming with him.

ctx.x: It was cold. We got up to New Hampshire and we got snow bound in the bus.
Clarence Holiday might have been in the band at that time, a guitar player; or Charlie Turner, Charlie Turner was a bass player.
Slick Jones might have been in the band.
